summary: Chunk p05/ch07 k1 (units 1-37) reviewed. Draft is sound: split and grammar are mostly right, no invented content found, typo flags plausible (13 also confirmed by metre). Fixes: supplied words (Hindi/English 'and', 'pains', 'applications'), unhedged probable/disputed identifications (kola in 10 and 30, śyāmā in 25 and 30), Hindi wording (9, 13, 24, 26, 31, 33), gram labels (sneha-āvṛtam, sa-mūtraiḥ, kaṭūnām, ūrdhvebhyaḥ, -vat). Needs human decision: 3 (metre does not support abhukta conjecture), 9 to 12 (tailābhyām = two oils of rāsnā and pītadru), 23, 29, 32, 35 (alternative conjectures), 8/16 (15-syllable lines; possible snehamāvṛtaṃ). Identifications judged acceptable: rāsnā probable, pītadru and śyāmā disputed, tamaka and udāvarta probable, trivṛt, bilva, arka, kulattha, yava standard. No regrouping needed (GROUPING notes are sensible; 37 continues beyond the chunk).
glossary_suggestions: Hindi: bare आम can read as 'mango'; at first use write 'आम यानी अपक्व अवस्था'.
X-āvṛta: tat-puruṣa 'covered by X' only when X is the coverer (pitta-āvṛtam); 'sneha-āvṛtam' with a separate coverer = 'the sneha, covered' (no tat-puruṣa).
Probable identifications (kola = jujube) are hedged in both translations; disputed ones (pītadru, śyāmā) carry '(identity disputed)' / 'जिसकी पहचान विवादित है' in both translations.
-vat (yavakolakulatthavān) is a possessive suffix, not bahuvrīhi.
aruci: modern equivalent 'anorexia / loss of appetite' may be added in the gloss (standard).
Metre (16 syllables) is usable as evidence for typo flags: tṛḍadāha in 13 (17 as printed, 16 corrected); lines 8 and 16 have 15 (possible lost 'ma' in snehamāvṛtaṃ).
